2121516516520735015.en_summary: Hardware is falling again. One month into the selloff, Micron is down 15% and NVIDIA is down 26% over the month. Overnight the hardware perpetuals are under pressure: all 8 hardware names are down on the day; Sandisk is the biggest faller, down 7%; NVIDIA is holding up best, down 3%. Funding has flipped positive on its 24-hour average, with longs paying 15 to 17% annualized to hold Micron and NVIDIA over the weekend. The pre-IPO lab marks are moving with the hardware. Anthropic is down 2% on the day in its own perpetual market and OpenAI is down 1% on the day; the labs are ahead of the hardware by about 4 points on the day. With the Anthropic roadshow under way and pricing targeted for November 24, the open question into the IPO is which side of this board prices the deal.
2121516516520735015.zh_summary: 硬件再次下跌。抛售已持續一個月，Micron 本月下跌 15%，NVIDIA 下跌 26%。隔夜硬件永續合約承壓：全部 8 個名稱當日下跌；Sandisk 跌幅最大，下跌 7%；NVIDIA 相對抗跌，下跌 3%。資金費率轉正，多頭支付 15 至 17% 年化利率以持有 Micron 和 NVIDIA 過週末。IPO 前實驗室市值隨硬件移動。Anthropic 當日在其永續市場下跌 2%，OpenAI 下跌 1%；實驗室領先硬件約 4 個百分點。Anthropic 路演進行中，定價目標為 11 月 24 日；IPO 的開放問題是哪一方為交易定價。

2121515686518300716.en_summary: SpaceX shareholders love the word orbit. But the booster went to sea and then to flame again. Is full reusability still only on PowerPoint? Starship's investor value is not reaching orbit but bringing the same system back cheaply, quickly and repeatably. If it catches on Saturday I apologize. If not, I will object to the temporary delay narrative again.
2121515686518300716.zh_summary: SpaceX 股東熱愛軌道這個詞。但助推器再次掉入海中然後起火。完全可重複使用是否仍停留在 PowerPoint 上？Starship 的投資者價值不在於進入軌道，而在於將同一系統以低成本、快速且可重複的方式帶回。如果星期六抓住了我道歉。如果沒有，我將再次反對暫時延遲的敘述。
